did: On the server's drift epic, every one of home's hundred tables now says how its rows live. A test fails if a kept record loses its guard, or if code deletes one outside the deletes you already ruled on; it caught the new fast-track delete the day it landed. The nudge waker, the biggest file in the repo, is split into its stages, and a test stops any of them growing back. Dead code and thirty-six missing crate READMEs are gone, with a check so a manifest can't name a file that isn't there. It all landed in server bucket 1; the clock clean-up was left because it reaches the transcriber's files.
left: A one-commit follow-up, server claude/drift-server-nov22 (cb84c71), updates lifecycle.rs's voice_note_fast_track reason and schema.md now that some-ui's discard-sites row names it; it goes in the next server bucket.
The clock clean-up (S3, server#483) waits: it reaches the transcriber's files.
